quality.method: Signed corner scaled Jacobian relative to polygon area normal; 3D included corner angles; max/min edge ratio; adjacent polygon area ratio; unique-edge length CV; graph valence; actual count error. Separate from manifold/surface validation.

guideSampleMethod: 257 uniformly spaced authored arc-length samples per guide, measured against its connected output-edge path.
limits: Measured surface/topology checks are bounded; they do not certify absence of every3D self intersection or exact native equivalence.

02.scope: Adaptive triangle subdivision with convex point-to-triangle upper bounds in both directions. Double precision with a roundoff margin; unresolved depth/work budgets reject. Does not check topology or intersections.

13.scope: Adaptive triangle subdivision with convex point-to-triangle upper bounds in both directions. Double precision with a roundoff margin; unresolved depth/work budgets reject. Does not check topology or intersections.

surfaceValidation.scope: Both quad diagonals require adaptive whole-triangle distance bounds in both directions; budgets reject unresolved bounds. Double-precision checks, separate from intersections.

intersectionValidation.scope: Indexed polygon bounds and triangle contact vertices, fan triangulation, 1e-9 length tolerance. Contacts are allowed only on common topological vertices/edges (4e-9 boundary tolerance). Floating-point screen; degeneracy and manifold checks are separate.
